principle: Footage explains the idea; typography carries the argument; effects mark a change in meaning.

motionGrammar: soft-pop plus underline for the conclusion

retentionPreset.opening: 0-3s authored headline over full-screen speaker, immediate punch-in, one low impact, and a second cue on the first semantic keyword
retentionPreset.bodyEmphasis: Use short full-frame flash or zoom-blur only at changes in meaning; allow two independent typography beats per minute outside captions.
retentionPreset.rule: A retention cue must mark a new claim, proof, metaphor, or consequence. Never add motion only to fill time.

tokenPolicy.stt: one fresh local pass; second pass only for low-confidence words
tokenPolicy.render: quiet 10-second hook preview, then one full render after approval or visual QA
tokenPolicy.qa: one contact sheet plus decode and loudness checks

user-footage.rule: Use the user's own relevant moving footage before any generated or stock asset.

licensed-stock.rule: Use moving stock footage only when the action or location is concrete and the source plus license are recorded.

generated-video.rule: Generate a short realistic moving shot for a specific visual idea when suitable user footage or licensed stock is unavailable.

generated-photo-ken-burns-fallback.rule: Last resort only. Generate a realistic still without text and animate a restrained 1.0 to 1.035 push-in.

skin-neutral-social.use: Bright indoor phone footage with warm skin and cool background.
skin-neutral-social.caption: #FFF8F2
